content: MK reports that this prediction appears to have been common knowledge in the later Timurid period, since Davānī, in his R. Tuḥfa-yi Rūḥānī, cites it as a prime example of making political predictions from the names of the actors involved (Majlis 5180 p. 420, Majlis 12559 p. 260, per MK's footnote on pdf p.329).
